newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai soybeans end mixed on liquidation.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai soybeans end mixed on liquidation.

text.p: Shanghai soybean futures ended lower in dull trading on Tuesday with open interest falling further on liquidation before the two-week Chinese lunar new year holiday, traders said.
The key March 1997 contract ended at 3,140 yuan ($378) per tonne, losing six yuan. It opened at 3,140 and stayed at that level for the whole session.
May fell 20 to 3,220, July rose eight to 3,266, September fell six to 3,349, November fell one to 3,380 and the January 1998 rose 20 to 3,400.
Combined volume fell to 10,300 tonnes from 17,100.
